author: Inside Edition
description: Many people are still digging out from the record snowfall that hit parts of the U.S. earlier this week. In the aftermath of the winter storm, giant piles of snow remain both on the ground and on top of cars. Now, police are sending out a serious warning: clean the snow off your car, or, in certain states, you'll be fined. It's not just cosmetic; flying ice is a safety hazard, and can even shatter a car windshield. Inside Edition's Steven Fabian has more.
title: How To Keep Ice From Flying Off Your Car

author: Inside Edition
description: Tips are flooding in. The $1 million dollar reward NBC News journalist Savannah Guthrie is offering for information about her missing mother is generating an avalanche of new information. Nancy Guthrie was reported missing from her Tucson, Arizona, home on February 1. One new theory about the missing octogenarian suggests that Guthrie's kidnappers used a tunnel in Tucson to escape. Some of those tunnels go all the way to the Mexican border. Inside Edition's Jim Moret has more.
title: Did Nancy Guthrie Kidnappers Escape Using Tunnels?

author: Inside Edition
description: Juliette Ojeda is drawing rave reviews for her rendition of the theme song from "Titanic." The clip of the singer belting "My Heart Will Go On" into a hairbrush has gone viral. Among the millions of people who have viewed it: that song's original singer, Celine Dion herself. Juliette, who has performed on Broadway, recently visited with Inside Edition's Alison Hall, and she had a special message for Celine.
title: Singer's Gives Pitch Perfect 'Titanic' Theme Rendition Using Hairbrush

author: Inside Edition
description: Friends and fans are sharing their support for "Only Murders in the Building" star Martin Short after his daughter took her own life. It's just the latest tragedy for the noted funnyman, who has spent his life making others laugh. The Short family released a statement that read in part, "It is with profound grief that we confirm the passing of Katherine Hartley Short. The Short family is devastated by this loss." Katherine was 42 years old.
title: Martin Short's Daughter Dies At 42

author: Inside Edition
description: Colin Gray is on trial in Georgia for giving his teenage son Colt Gray the assault rifle he allegedly used to kill four people at his high school in 2024. Colin says he did, and could not know his son was planning an attack at the school. Now, Colt's mother Marcee Gray, who is estranged from Colin, is taking the stand. Marcee testified that their son's behavior leading up to the shooting was “alarming." Colt Gray is being charged as an adult, and a date for his trial has not yet been set.
title: Mother Of Alleged School Shooter Testifies His Behavior Was 'Alarming'

author: Inside Edition
description: "Survivor" is celebrating a big milestone, as the legendary reality television series marks its 50th season this year. The anniversary has many people wondering what happened to the breakout stars from the show's very first season, back in the year 2000. Hosted by Jeff Probst and shot on the island of Borneo, the inaugural season offered a million dollar prize to the winning contestant. Inside Edition's Les Trent has more.
title: What Happened To The Stars Of 'Survivor's' First Season?

author: Inside Edition
description: Severe winter weather often prompts people to “panic shop.” But one shopper found herself in a real panic when the store closed with her still inside. Elise Levin recorded the unusual situation from inside a New York supermarket. Firefighters were eventually summoned to free her from the store, and she was even able to keep her groceries for free. The store's owner says the doors were locked due to an oversight by his employees.
title: Shopper Gets Trapped Inside Supermarket

author: Inside Edition
description: Officials in New York say a trooper is lucky to be alive after getting hit on the side of a highway by an out of control SUV. The New York State Police say troopers were on a state route in the Adirondack Mountains, responding to a property damage call. They say bodycam video from Trooper Bailey Martin shows the moment the Dodge Durango came barreling through a stop sign and right into her. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Police Say NY State Trooper Hit By Car That Blew Stop Sign

author: Inside Edition
description: Utah children's book author Kouri Richins is accused of poisoning her husband's cocktail.
title: Police Bodycam Video Played During Grief Author's Murder Trial #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: A seagull flew a little too close to the action when it was hit with a soccer ball during a game in Istanbul. Even though it wasn't a team member, players rushed over to check on the bird. One of them performed chest compressions to try and revive the unconscious animal. The whole game stopped and the audience was mostly silent, hoping for a good sign. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Seagull Knocked Unconscious By Soccer Ball During Championship Game

author: Inside Edition
description: NYPD officers responded to 911 calls of a "disorderly crowd" at Washington Square Park, and they ended up becoming the target of snowballs.
title: Cops Pelted With Snowballs #shorts
